title: [UE-21] Open umbrella lifts, no lift falls at gravity
body:
### MVP item (number from docs/jam-brief.md), Day 0, or Stretch: <name>

2

### GDD ref (section + short quote; "none" for tooling cards)

§3 "Only an open, upright umbrella creates lift" (GDD RULE)

### GDD revision (the one in docs/gdd/CURRENT, e.g. 1.3)

SH1.0

### Features (IDs from docs/feature-manifest.json; add "Hook only" for an interface + default flag with no behavior, OPEN/PROPOSED only; "none" for tooling cards)

MOVE-13, MOVE-21

### Player outcome (the player sees X, does Y, can tell why; "none" for tooling cards)

The player releases both buttons, sees Ella rise with the open umbrella, and can tell lift comes only from the open umbrella

### Owner role

Gameplay Dev

### Reviewer role (must differ from owner)

Dev Lead

### Human who runs and merges this

Josh

### Inputs and outputs (exact paths)

Inputs: docs/feature-manifest.json approved_parameters. Outputs: `Source/UmbrellaElla/Public/Umbrella/**`, `Source/UmbrellaElla/Private/Umbrella/**`, `Source/UmbrellaElla/Private/Tests/Umbrella/**`, the QA-01 row of `pipeline/qa/test-map.md`

### Context (what the code or asset next to Outputs does today, with file:line)

new files only

### File lane, do-not-touch paths, binary files to lock

Lane: Source/UmbrellaElla/{Public,Private}/Umbrella/**, Source/UmbrellaElla/{Public,Private}/Motor/**, Source/UmbrellaElla/Private/Tests/Umbrella/**, pipeline/qa/test-map.md
Do not touch: Content/UmbrellaElla/Maps/**
Locks: none

### Out of scope (behaviors not to build; the reviewer rejects them)

anything outside the lane

### After (cards that must merge first: #<n> or UE-<n>, comma separated; "none")

UE-0.5, UE-0.6

### Used by (BPs, maps, widgets or components that read what this card changes; follow-up card IDs)

UE-0.27 (the workbench ports the umbrella flags)

### Needs (build | tests | editor MCP | Windows packaging machine)

build, tests, Windows packaging machine

### Done when (each line checkable)

- [ ] `tools/ue/test.sh --require UmbrellaElla.Umbrella.OpenRises --require UmbrellaElla.Umbrella.NoLiftFallsAtGravity --require UmbrellaElla.Umbrella.World.NoLiftMatchesNoUmbrellaFall` prints PASS
- [ ] Rise speed reaches 300 cm/s ±5 cm/s within 0.5 s in `UmbrellaElla.Umbrella.OpenRises`
- [ ] package + SMOKE_OK with input=ok and input_vz below 0 on L_Graybox (`tools\ue\smoke.ps1` prints PASS)
- [ ] QA-01 row in pipeline/qa/test-map.md set to merged with this card's number

### Budget and cut tier

60 min agent + 15 min human, MVP

### Unknowns (Decision needed / Why it matters / Proposed test / Choice; "none" if none)

none
